properties.NAME: Indiana Terr.
properties.CHANGE: The United States created Indiana Territory from the Northwest Territory; included all of present Illinois and Wisconsin, and parts of present Indiana, Michigan, Minnesota, and Ohio. Map depicts non-county area in Indiana Territory in present Michigan.
properties.CITATION: (Terr. Papers U.S., 3:86-88; U.S. Stat., vol. 2, ch. 41 [1800]/pp. 58-59)
